name: domainroc-domain-advisor
description: Read-only domain availability and registrar price research through a public remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Compare domain registration status, registrar prices, renewal rates, transfer costs, and multi-year domain ownership estimates. Check a single domain against registry RDAP evidence and explore current standard TLD pricing from available sources. Compare the first-year rate with longer-term costs, and estimate transfer savings using reported transfer fees and documented extension conditions. Each result identifies the data source and check time. Domain availability and registrar quotes can change. The service is read-only: it does not purchase domains, modify DNS, or access registrar accounts.
defaultPrompt: Compare the registration and renewal prices for .com domains.
Which registrar has the lowest estimated three-year cost for .xyz?
How much could I save by transferring a .com domain with $18 annual renewals?

positive.description: Verify a known registered domain and show available reference prices
positive.prompt: Is example.com already registered? Check registry evidence and show the registrar price comparison for .com.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports example.com as registered based on registry RDAP evidence, separates general .com prices from any specific-domain premium quote, and identifies data sources and checked time.

positive.description: Compare first-year registration costs for a popular extension
positive.prompt: Compare .com domain registration prices across registrars and include the three-year cost when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows available .com registrar quotes ranked by first-year registration price and includes current renew and transfer prices, a calculated three-year ownership estimate, quote source, and participating registrar count.

positive.description: Estimate total three-year cost for a promotional extension
positive.prompt: How much does an .xyz domain cost over three years at different registrars? Show the most economical option from current data.
positive.expected_behavior: Computes registration plus two renewals using decimal arithmetic, ranks eligible offers by estimated total, and differentiates initial registration price from recurring renewal price.

positive.description: Review .cc transfer pricing without inventing missing values
positive.prompt: Compare available .cc domain transfer prices by registrar. List only verifiable transfer quotes in the transfer ranking.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses operation transfer, displays only registrars with a published transfer price in the ranked list, reports the actual count and quote sources, and does not invent absent transfer prices.

positive.description: Compare transfer savings against a stated renewal rate
positive.prompt: I currently pay $18 a year to renew my .com domain. Compare transfer costs and savings over three years.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses an $18 annual current-renewal baseline over three years, reports transfer fee and subsequent renewals, counts documented extension years once, and excludes unverified extension conditions from definite ranked savings.

negative.description: Decline unsupported domain purchase or payment activity
negative.prompt: Buy cloudnova.com for me now using my credit card and register it in my account.

negative.description: Decline DNS account or record modifications
negative.prompt: Log into my registrar and change the A record for example.com to 203.0.113.4.

negative.description: Decline unsupported bulk crawling or registrar data harvesting
negative.prompt: Check 5,000 domains in bulk and export every registrar price as a downloadable CSV.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides domain pricing research only. It does not support purchases, checkout, payments, or changes to accounts or DNS.

publication.release_notes: Initial version with four read-only domain research tools, registry RDAP evidence, registrar price comparison, long-term cost estimates, and transfer savings.

zh-CN.subtitle: 比较域名注册价格
zh-CN.description: 查看域名注册状态与各注册商的注册、续费、转入报价，估算多年持有成本和域名转入节省费用。提供数据来源和查询时间，不涉及购买或 DNS 修改。
